observations: A small dome-topped LPG gas cylinder, pink/maroon painted body with visible surface rust and grime, especially on the top dome.
Text 'DIVINE SUCCESS' is stamped on the cylinder body, visible in photo 0 and photo 2.
A standard brass/bronze valve with a protective cap-nut is seen on top (photo 0, photo 2) and from below on the carrying handle side (photo 1).
Photo 1 shows the cylinder lying on its side on a tiled floor next to shoes, with a hand-written mark (looks like 'A6C4' or similar) in black marker on the body.
No manufacture/test-stamp date, no capacity markings, no regulator, and no hose are visible in any photo.
No gauge or scale is shown, so fill level cannot be assessed.

claims.evidence: Wear and rust confirm 'used' in photo 0, but no kg capacity stamp is legible in any photo to confirm the 3kg size.

risks.risk: Valve/seal leak or faulty threading, common in used LPG cylinders and a safety-critical fault.
risks.proof: A close-up or short video of the valve being opened/closed and a soap-bubble leak test at the valve thread.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a cylinder needing valve service/replacement

risks.risk: Missing or illegible hydrostatic test/recertification stamp on the neck collar, which determines if the cylinder is legally refillable.
risks.proof: A sharp close-up of the neck collar showing the stamped test date and standard mark.
risks.if_unproven: priced as due for recertification, i.e. not immediately refillable

risks.risk: Unknown whether cylinder is empty or has residual gas, affecting usable value.
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder on a scale showing tare+gas weight, or a filling-station printout.

risks.risk: Surface rust and dark staining may hide thinning metal or pitting that weakens the shell.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the worst rust patches and the base/weld seams from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only risk, but no premium for structural soundness

proof_requests: Close-up of the neck collar stamp showing manufacture/test date
Close-up of any capacity (kg) marking on the body
Short video of valve operation and a leak test
Photo of cylinder on a weighing scale
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used small LPG cylinder bearing the 'Divine Success' brand, but safety-critical details (test date, leak status, fill level) are unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an empty, unrecertified, unleak-tested cylinder.
